addedWinners.title: Galactic Disaster Season 5: A Promise Upon the Snow — Main Content
addedWinners.summary: Chapter 1/Celestial Bulwark seasonal rewards: after October 21 maintenance to before December 23 maintenance. September 30 Chapter 0/preview is a separate opening. Unlocks: Viadeus after October 21 maintenance; Seraphion October 28 at 02:00 UTC; Enforcer Seraphion November 4 at 02:00 UTC. These are unlocks, not separate expirations. Includes the Supply Store using earned Relics of a Frozen Civilization. Exact maintenance times unconfirmed.

addedWinners.title: Nightmare Dream Park
addedWinners.summary: Build and manage the theme park and earn its achievement rewards from after October 21 maintenance until before December 23 maintenance. Season-limited reward items are removed after Galactic Disaster Season 5 ends. Exact opening and closing times are unconfirmed.

addedWinners.title: Rossweisse Trauma Code: Blade Poised Against the Cycle
addedWinners.summary: Limited-time Trauma Code achievements and event-battle rewards run from after October 21 maintenance until before December 2 maintenance. This is the limited reward window, not a claim that the underlying story disappears. Special Security Codes are required to unlock Trauma Codes even during this event. Exact opening and closing times are unconfirmed.
